name: ColorPicker
description: A color field: a swatch that opens a popover (saturation and brightness area, hue and opacity sliders, format select, eyedropper and preset swatches) and a text value that is always available for typing. On the behavior engine's color-picker machine (Zag).

livewire.name: color-picker
capabilities: wire:model binds value (text in the current format) through $wire.entangle()
colorpicker stays as a deprecated alias

props.name: value
props.description: The color as text in any of the formats (#1f74bf, rgb(…), hsl(…), oklch(…)); reported back in the current format. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial color of an uncontrolled picker.

props.name: format
props.description: The text format of the value. The format select switches it, rewriting the value. Emitted as data-format.

props.name: alpha
props.description: Offers opacity: the opacity slider, and an alpha in the text (#rrggbbaa, / 0.5) when below 1. Off keeps every value opaque.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colors as text, such as the brand palette, shown in the popover.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height, matching Input. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the text value.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the field, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.
props.a11y: Sets aria-invalid on the text value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and the popover's controls.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.
props.a11y: Sets required on the text value.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popover is open. Vue binds it with v-model:open. Emitted as data-state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled popover.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the popover at the end of the body (x-teleport, a React portal, Vue Teleport). Off renders it in place.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The swatch button's and the popover's accessible name. Translated by default.

props.name: areaLabel
props.description: The area's accessible name. Translated by default.

props.name: hueLabel
props.description: The hue slider's accessible name. Translated by default.

props.name: alphaLabel
props.description: The opacity slider's accessible name. Translated by default.

props.name: formatLabel
props.description: The format select's accessible name. Translated by default.

props.name: eyeDropperLabel
props.default: Pick a color from the screen
props.description: The eyedropper's accessible name. Translated by default.

props.name: swatchesLabel
props.description: The preset swatch group's accessible name. Translated by default.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { trigger: '…', content: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, box, hint and error, then the popover. Zag's root part.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the text value.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the text value is required.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered box around the trigger and the text value: Zag's control part, renamed to the field anatomy's box (D-018).

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The spec's swatch: a button at the start of the box that opens the popover. Zag's trigger.

parts.name: swatch
parts.description: A color fill: the current color in the trigger, or a preset in a swatch trigger.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The text value, always visible. Enter or blur sets the color from any format. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: hint
parts.description: Help text.

parts.name: error
parts.description: Validation message, with an icon.

parts.name: positioner
parts.description: Places the popover under the field.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The popover (role=dialog), named by triggerLabel.

parts.name: area
parts.description: The saturation (inline axis) and brightness (block axis) area.

parts.name: areaBackground
parts.description: The area's gradients, drawn by the machine for the current hue.

parts.name: areaThumb
parts.description: The spec's cursor: a 2D slider (role=slider) with aria-valuetext.

parts.name: channelSlider
parts.description: A channel slider, data-channel="hue" or "alpha".

parts.name: channelSliderTrack
parts.description: The slider's track, with the channel's gradient.

parts.name: channelSliderThumb
parts.description: The slider's thumb (role=slider), with aria-valuetext in degrees or percent.

parts.name: transparencyGrid
parts.description: The checkerboard under the opacity slider's gradient.

parts.name: row
parts.description: The row with the format select and the eyedropper.

parts.name: formatSelect
parts.description: A native select of the text formats: HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH.

parts.name: eyeDropperTrigger
parts.description: Picks a color from the screen. Hidden where the browser has no EyeDropper API.

parts.name: swatchGroup
parts.description: role=group of the preset swatches, named by swatchesLabel.

parts.name: swatchTrigger
parts.description: One preset, named by its value, aria-pressed while it is the color.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The color changed: dragged, typed, picked, chosen from a swatch, or rewritten by a format change. Reports the text in the current format.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The popover opened or closed itself: the trigger, Escape or an outside click. Setting open doesn't fire it.

events.name: format-change
events.description: The format select changed the text format.

keyboard.action: Moves between the trigger and the text value; in the popover, between the area, the sliders, the format select, the eyedropper and the swatches.
On the trigger, opens the popover; on a swatch, chooses it.
On the area, less or more saturation; on a slider, less or more of its channel. They follow the text direction, so they swap under RTL.
On the area, more or less brightness; on a slider, more or less of its channel.
In the text value, sets the color from the typed text.
Closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger.

requirements: The text value is always visible outside the popover and always available for typing, in any of the four formats.
The area and sliders are keyboard-operable role=slider elements with aria-valuetext ("72%, 75%", "208°", "80%").
The area and sliders mirror under RTL, and ArrowLeft and ArrowRight follow the text direction.
Swatches are buttons named by their value, with aria-pressed on the current one, in a named group.
The trigger is labelled and reports aria-expanded and aria-controls; the popover is a named dialog.
The eyedropper is hidden where the browser can't pick from the screen.
Every built-in label is a translatable prop.
Hint and error are linked to the text value with aria-describedby; invalid sets aria-invalid.
Every server-rendered part keeps a stable id in Livewire; the popover is wire:ignore (D-015).
